excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]报告其在[From.GetName]发现了行星规模的晶体，晶体携带并不断产生自然电荷。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] reports that it has found a planetside deposit of crystals carrying - and generating - a natural charge, on [From.GetName].
